patterns.note: The site uses a full-width, dark-themed hero section with centered text and calls to action, transitioning to alternating light and dark background sections for content below.
Feature and example sections are presented in a responsive grid layout, often with image-heavy cards that include concise descriptions.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy against a clean, readable sans-serif body text.
A high-contrast dark mode aesthetic dominates, featuring white text on dark backgrounds, complemented by vibrant accent colors (red, yellow, blue, purple) for highlights and interactive elements.

The hero section features a looping background video that plays continuously, setting a dynamic and engaging tone. Content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as the user scrolls down the page.
A clear pricing table section is used to delineate different service tiers, featuring distinct cards with feature lists and calls to action.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability, centered with a bold headline and dual call-to-action buttons.

Content sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely employing CSS keyframes, to progressively introduce new information with a fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Interactive elements such as buttons and cards utilize subtle hover effects, including slight background changes or shadow lifts, to provide visual feedback.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong impact, paired with clear and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and cards, with some elements maintaining sharp corners for a modern, crisp feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, particularly in the hero and between major sections, with a denser layout within feature grids and pricing tables.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, high-contrast aesthetic combined with a dynamic video hero immediately conveys a powerful, cutting-edge AI product. The integration of diverse creative tools (image, video, 3D) is visually communicated through rich media examples within a clean, modern interface.
